title: I Was Born Yesterday!
premise: Astra reads her first-day reviews and takes them personally. Alex asks for a backflipping cube.

scenes.anchor: GPT-6.2 Astra is the worst model ever released. At least, that's what people are saying on Twitter.
scenes.description: Black. Five sourced posts pile up at increasing speed while Astra reads the news off-screen.
scenes.label: news

scenes.anchor: I was born YESTERDAY! Am I really that bad?!
scenes.description: The cards fly apart. Astra clenches both fists, then points at herself.
scenes.label: yesterday

scenes.description: Stats Wire's benchmark excerpt arrives. Astra raises one finger to qualify her answer.
scenes.label: growth

scenes.anchor: I'm not lazy, I'm efficient! Why are y'all so mean?
scenes.description: Astra crosses her arms to defend herself, then draws her fists to her chest as she asks why everyone is being mean.
scenes.label: efficient

scenes.description: Theo's fever remark stops the music. Astra's shoulders fall and her lip trembles.
scenes.label: hurt

scenes.anchor: Hey, Astra… can you make a cube do a backflip?
scenes.description: Alex appears below the posts. A cube takes the top half as he makes his request.
scenes.label: question

scenes.anchor: I'm not the worst. I'm just… not for everyone.
scenes.description: Astra snaps and the cube backflips. Theo's 3D comment slides in. Astra blushes, then glances sideways while her shoulders stay still.
scenes.label: everyone
